requirements.rule: V7 is the only normative standard; V6 and earlier text is historical evidence and cannot override V7.
A release remains a candidate until every mandatory static, browser, audio, live and evidence gate passes for the same SHA.
Every source quote, sentence split, cue, destination and derived teaching decision retains explicit provenance.
Future Boss Letter marks are visually absent until their deciding step and rewind cleanly.
The six authentic note headings retain three listening-only classifications and Task A plus Task B, Task B and Task C classifications.
The six authentic page-3 textareas are the only note surface; no synthetic worksheet may exist.
Generated notes and learner-authored notes are distinct, merge deterministically and survive reload, remount and chapter return.
podcast-v7.js is the only active owner of playback, cue selection, boundaries, transcript projection, note transactions and podcast persistence.
Legacy boundary timers, fallback listen calls, pause-state writers, duplicate marker layers and alternate active runtimes are prohibited.
Bootstrap creates primitives first, loads audited content helpers, installs V7, then restores exactly once; no earlier layer may mutate podcast state.
The audited meeting segment is [426.000, 838.790] media seconds and displays as [0:00, 6:52.790].
Listening is continuous: cue 1 starts at 426.000 and every later playbackStart equals the previous cue endpoint; the 17 intervals cover the complete segment without gaps or overlap.
Fresh Stage 3 entry is Cue 1/17 at display 0:00, with zero completed cues, zero transcript reveal marks and empty generated note fields.
Next resumes from the previous endpoint, Previous rewinds to the selected cue playbackStart, and a pin replays its complete interval rather than jumping to its source utterance.
Seeking maps to the cue whose endpoint follows the playhead, never to an isolated source span, and rewinds downstream generated state deterministically.
Each cue records stable ID, playbackStart, sourceStart, sourceEnd, endpoint, destination, text, task and source turn.
A cue pauses and writes only after its source endpoint, and cue, playhead, destination and exact answer must agree atomically.
All 17 cues are played through their complete continuous intervals in the release gate; direct note injection cannot certify audio alignment.
Podcast state is versioned as V7 and stores cue ID, playhead, done state and completedThrough as one validated invariant.
Reload and leave-return during an unfinished cue restore the same cue and playhead without erasing completed generated or learner notes.
Every transcript utterance has separate speaker and copy elements; any rejection line crosses copy only.
At 0:00 no transcript answer colour or rejection line is revealed; each mark appears only after its utterance endpoint and persists until rewind.
The active utterance is highlighted and followed smoothly; programmatic follow never disables itself, while wheel or touch interaction explicitly disables follow.
Move, resize, translation, follow and fit controls preserve a readable copy column and stable speaker separation.
At each cue endpoint the source utterance, expanded evidence panel and destination textarea are visibly connected.
Exactly one player, one timeline, one pin layer and 17 pins exist; the pin-toggle label and aria-pressed state match visibility.
Listening reports 1/17 through 17/17; transcript sentence review is a separate sub-stage and may never appear as 166 audio stops.
Each sentence has one primary type; the contact sentence is Type 5 and the separate rumours sentence is Type 6.
Multi-task meaning is written as Task A plus Task B with separate readable badges, never unexplained A/B shorthand.
Task colour may cover the complete model sentence while nested syntax words retain their independent purple layer.
Reveal, route, typewriter, strike, focus, transcript-follow and source-preview motion has an equivalent reduced-motion state.
Repeated native remounts create no duplicate IDs, listeners, player, transcript, timeline, pins or controls and lose no notes.
Controls, task meaning, follow state, pin visibility and cue progress are understandable by keyboard and assistive technology without colour dependence.
Player, transcript, dock, source sheet and evidence panels remain readable without overlap at supported desktop, mobile and zoomed viewports.
Tests load unmodified production scripts and reject every orphan legacy player, transcript, timer, worksheet and pin layer.
Chromium and Firefox both prove fresh entry and a real first cue; Chromium proves all 17 complete continuous intervals, reload and chapter return.
requirements.evidence: browser output, cue log and screenshots

requirements.rule: Focused CI runs V7 static validation, verbatim validation, Chromium, Firefox, real audio and artifact preparation before deployment.
Publication is incomplete until release.json and the cache-busted public runtime expose the intended SHA and V7 handshake.
Every conforming release archives Chromium and Firefox screenshots, the 17-cue transaction ledger, browser output, workflow URL, public SHA and approved variances.
Every known failure records symptom, root cause, violated invariant, correction, rationale, expected result, diagnostic and regression test.
Troubleshooting begins with measured runtime state—SHA, architecture handshake, cue ID, playbackStart, source span, playhead, destination and completedThrough—never visual guesswork alone.
